'''Moryo Bean''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was worked for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Invasion of Taris|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], he was stationed at the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Toxic Lake Garrison]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Moryo Bean first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]] as the cantina vendor for the Empire on Taris.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> he was removed from the game along with the rest of the Vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
